Our experienced designers work closely with you to understand your goals, preferences, and budget before bringing your ideas to life through 3D renderings and material selections. From custom cabinetry and durable quartz countertops to elegant backsplashes and ambient lighting, every element is chosen to balance form and function. Whether you prefer a sleek, contemporary kitchen or a warm, coastal-inspired design, North2South Renovations tailors every detail to your lifestyle while ensuring each component is installed with expert craftsmanship and care.

The result is a stunning, high-performance kitchen that enhances both your home’s appeal and your daily life. General Contracting in Palm Beach Florida

South Florida has some of the strictest building codes in the country — and for good reason. Here’s what homeowners in Palm Beach County should know before starting a major renovation:

Projects
Licensed General Contractor in Palm Beach County

When your project goes beyond a single room — a whole-home renovation, a structural change, an addition, or any job that requires permits and multiple trades working in sequence — you need more than a remodeler. You need a licensed general contractor who can take full responsibility for the project from the first drawing to the final inspection.

North2South Renovations is a fully licensed and insured Florida general contractor- License #CBC1269429- based in Palm Beach County, with 15 years of hands-on renovation experience across Boca Raton, Boynton Beach, Delray Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, and the surrounding communities. We manage the entire project — permitting, scheduling, subcontractors, inspections, and quality control — so you have one accountable point of contact from start to finish.

Construction Permitting and code compliance.

We prepare and submit permit applications with the Palm Beach County Building Division or your city's building department, coordinate required documents, and schedule every inspection through final approval.

Multi-trade coordination

Larger renovations involve electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians, drywall crews, tile setters, and finish carpenters — all of whom need to show up in the right order. We schedule, supervise, and quality-check every trade so the project moves without gaps or rework.
